title: OpenAI API / SDK
simpleMetaphor: Plug-and-play AI intelligence for text generation, vision, and function execution in your app.
technicalExplanation: API endpoints exposing state-of-the-art LLMs (GPT-4o) for semantic reasoning and embeddings.

title: LangChain
simpleMetaphor: Framework for chaining LLMs together with external tools, vector databases, and memory.
technicalExplanation: Framework designed to simplify building applications powered by language models with agentic workflows.

title: Ollama
simpleMetaphor: Run powerful open-source AI models (Llama 3) locally on your own machine.
technicalExplanation: Tool for bundling and running open-source large language models locally via a REST interface.

title: Git
simpleMetaphor: Time machine for your code that tracks history, branches, and team contributions.
technicalExplanation: Distributed version control system tracking source code modifications.

title: Vite
simpleMetaphor: Lightning-fast modern build tool and dev server replacement for Webpack.
technicalExplanation: Frontend build tool leveraging native ES Modules and Esbuild for near-instant dev server startup.

title: Turborepo
simpleMetaphor: Speeds up build times in projects containing multiple apps and shared packages.
technicalExplanation: High-performance build system for JavaScript and TypeScript monorepos.

title: Biome
simpleMetaphor: Ultra-fast single tool replacing both ESLint and Prettier in Rust.
technicalExplanation: High-performance toolchain written in Rust for formatting, linting, and organizing imports.
